entities.summary: Cameron Tyler Jordan is an American professional football defensive end. He played college football for the California Golden Bears, and was selected by the New Orleans Saints in the first round of the 2011 NFL draft. A member of the NFL 2010s All-Decade Team, Jordan is an eight-time Pro Bowler, a three-time All-Pro selection, is the Saints' all-time franchise sack leader, and currently ranks 17th all-time in sacks.
